item.text:
The account uses Nairobi time and USD. The flight will run from midnight on December 7 through the end of December 18 locally—December 6 at 21:00 UTC to December 18 at 21:00 UTC.

I’m setting up direct-trial and Christmas-invitation groups, restricted to iPhone and Android phones in the four supported countries. Their lifetime caps will total $400. With no X pixel, delivery will optimize for link clicks; that won’t tell us which ads produce completed trials.

item.text: The first 36 hours report $44.88 spent, 26,656 impressions and 30 link clicks. Both groups are delivering within budget. The click counts are still small, so I’m keeping the initial split while more data comes in; these reports contain no completed-trial data.

So far, the direct-trial group has 37 link clicks at about $1.41 each; the invitation group has 33 at about $1.55 each. I’m modestly shifting the budget toward direct trials, from 50/50 to 60/40, and increasing daily pacing to catch up with the flight budget. The combined lifetime cap stays at $400. This adjustment is based on click costs, not evidence of trial starts.

item.text: X now reports $278.98 spent, 192,028 impressions and 187 link clicks. Pacing is close to plan, with $121.02 left under the shared cap. The December 18 local end time remains in place, leaving recipients time to start their own trials before the December 24 invitation deadline.

At noon Nairobi time on the final day, reported spend is $382.57, with 252 link clicks. The two groups have $17.43 left under their combined caps. I’ll verify delivery has ended at midnight Nairobi time and pull the closing totals.

The campaign ran December 7–18, 2026, on Nairobi’s local calendar, using only your four approved posts. It has ended, and all ad groups are paused.

X’s reported totals:

- Spend: **$395.79** of $400
- Impressions: **259,391**
- Link clicks: **261**
- Average cost per link click: **$1.52**

I monitored daily and shifted budget modestly toward the direct-trial group’s cheaper clicks.

**Completed trial starts remain unverified:** X had no pixel, and your service’s records weren’t available here. Clicks and invitations sent are not counted as trial starts.
